description: This file defines the PreferLocalPlacementDirector class, a placement strategy for activating grains in Orleans. It extends RandomPlacementDirector and attempts to place new activations in the local silo when suitable, otherwise falling back to random placement.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that prefers to activate grains in the local silo if appropriate. It extends RandomPlacementDirector and implements IPlacementDirector.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the activation request by checking local silo status and compatibility, and chooses to place the activation locally if conditions are met; otherwise, defers to the base implementation.
